title: Disclaimer
description: Guidelark provides general financial education, not personal financial advice. Read how to use the information on this site.
body:
## General information only

Everything on {{siteName}} is published for general education. It is not financial, legal, tax or investment advice, and it does not take your personal circumstances into account.

Before making a financial decision, check the figures against your own situation and, where the stakes are high, speak to a qualified professional in your country.

## Accuracy

I work to keep articles accurate and up to date, and I note when prices and product details were last checked. Even so, rates, fees, rules and app features change. Confirm details with the provider before relying on them.

## Examples and results

Worked examples use stated assumptions to show how a method works. Your results will differ. Nothing here is a promise of income, savings or any other outcome.

## External links

Articles link to other websites for reference. {{siteName}} is not responsible for their content.

## Affiliate links and sponsorship

At the time of the last update shown above, {{siteName}} does not use affiliate links or sponsored content. If that changes, affected articles will carry a clear notice and this page will be updated.
